# SpecReady

> SpecReady builds capability statements, statements of qualifications (SOQ packages), and pursuit packages for general contractors, engineering firms, and trades firms — assembled only from the buyer's own verifiable record: licenses, project history, personnel, and certifications the buyer actually holds. Every factual claim is tied to a source document in a source ledger, and the buyer attests in writing to every statement before delivery. SpecReady never invents, inflates, or borrows credentials.

SpecReady is a brand of Apex Grid Engineering PLLC. Domain: specreadyhq.com. Contact: info@specreadyhq.com.
Founder: Jeremy "Chico" Mills — Founder & CEO. Serial entrepreneur · USAF veteran. Jeremy Mills is the founder and owner of 10+ companies, led by Apex Grid Engineering. SpecReady is an Apex Grid Engineering PLLC company. Canonical bio: https://apexgrideng.com/about.

## Products and test pricing
- Capability Statement — $149: 1–2 page capability statement in house format, from a completed intake.
- SOQ Package — $349: capability statement plus project-history sheets and personnel/license pages, formatted to a named target's structure.
- Pursuit Package — $599: SOQ Package tailored to one live pursuit (format, page limits, and forms assembled from buyer facts).
- Update Pass — $99 (returning customers): refresh of a SpecReady-built package with new projects and facts.

## How it works
1. Structured intake captures the firm's facts once.
2. Source ledger: every claim is tied to a buyer-supplied source or a public record checked at build time. A claim with no source does not go in.
3. Assembly to the target's format where one exists, or SpecReady's house format.
4. Buyer proof and written attestation before final delivery.
5. Delivery: print-ready PDF plus an editable source file. One revision round is included in the quoted price.

## Policy
- Refund & Delivery Policy: https://specreadyhq.com/terms.html — refunds remedy SpecReady's failure (non-delivery, material defect, missed promised window); work performed is earned; a submitted or otherwise used package is not refundable for ordinary remorse. The buyer's policy acknowledgment rides the written scope confirmation at engagement.

## Boundaries
- SpecReady gives no eligibility advice for certifications or set-asides and implies no affiliation with any agency or prime contractor.
- Customer names, logos, and results are never used in SpecReady marketing without that customer's written consent.
